en.title: Game Awards Stage Invader Lands Interview With Joe Biden's Son
en.summary: The individual who famously interrupted The Game Awards in 2022 has resurfaced, this time set to engage in an interview with Hunter Biden. This unexpected turn follows his previous bizarre stage appearance.
en.body:
The unforgettable moment at The Game Awards 2022, where a stage invader awkwardly stood behind **Hidetaka Miyazaki** during **Elden Ring's** Game of the Year acceptance speech, has taken a peculiar new turn. The individual, who famously declared his desire to nominate "Orthodox rabbi Bill Clinton," was subsequently arrested and banned from future **The Game Awards** events. Now, in an unexpected development, he is scheduled to be interviewed by **Hunter Biden**, son of U.S. President Joe Biden.

This latest chapter adds another layer to the saga of the 2022 stage crasher. While his on-stage appearance was brief and bewildering, it certainly captured the attention of the gaming community and beyond. Security quickly removed him from the stage after his unusual pronouncement, leading to his arrest and a ban from the prestigious annual awards show. Despite the repercussions, the invader has seemingly found a way to maintain a public profile, albeit in a very different arena.

## The Invader's Notoriety

The 2022 incident at **The Game Awards** became an instant meme, largely due to the sheer unexpectedness of it all and the confused reactions of presenters and attendees, including **Miyazaki** himself. The individual's claim to have attended again in 2026, a detail that emerged from subsequent reporting, only added to the surreal nature of the event. His arrest and subsequent ban from **The Game Awards** seemed to signal the end of his brief foray into the gaming spotlight. However, this new interview arrangement suggests a continued interest in his story, or perhaps a deliberate attempt to amplify his notoriety through a controversial figure.

## Community Reactions and What's Next

For many fans, the initial stage invasion was a bizarre but ultimately harmless disruption to an otherwise celebratory evening for **Elden Ring**. The news of his upcoming interview with **Hunter Biden** has sparked a range of reactions online, from amusement at the sheer absurdity to criticism of platforms that might give a platform to individuals with such a history. It raises questions about how past actions, even those seemingly confined to a specific event, can lead to broader media attention. Details regarding the platform and timing of the interview have not yet been announced, leaving many to speculate on the nature and purpose of this unusual pairing.

What's Next

Fans will be watching to see when and where this interview takes place, and what the invader, **Hunter Biden**, or any involved platforms have to say about the context. The implications for the individual's public persona and the broader discussion around event security and media attention remain to be seen.

content_raw: You might remember in 2022 when a stage invader awkwardly stood behind Hidetaka Miyazaki during his Elden Ring acceptance speech at The Game Awards, before shuffling towards the mic at the end to nominate his “Orthodox rabbi Bill Clinton.” It was a bizarre moment, and I think Miyazaki’s bewildered face sums it up perfectly: nobody really knew what was going on.
